_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
SysID keeps the acceptance decision, independent band checks and missing low-pressure measurements visible above its detailed results. Rejected scans cannot supply accepted tuning.

PID adds a read-only NI pressure-fall trend and reported valve demand versus delivered duty. Dormant position-PID components are hidden during measured-rate deflation; exact active gains and pulse-filter lock remain explicitly unavailable.

The MAP viewer reads measured cuff holds and sensor provenance from archived simulator tables. Startup navigation now preserves an early tab selection. Offline pressure defaults to the calibrated NI sensor used by live BPF, and the legacy causal filter is labelled with its phase delay.

This Valinor GUI-only update retains gauge-38 firmware, Max presets, the 3 mmHg/s SysID target, controller parameters, estimator and accepted calibrations. Controller/MAP/SysID research candidates are not included. Same-input BPF agreement does not establish physical pulse preservation or independent arterial MAP accuracy.
